resources.string: No apps found. Open leanlauncherTV from the TV app list to reload.
Not the home app yet. Open Setup from the gear icon.
Could not open the home screen. Use Switch to leanlauncherTV below.
This device did not offer the change in-app. Try the one-press switch in Stock launcher switch, or use the manual steps below.
The system declined, or HOME still opens another app. Try the one-press switch in Stock launcher switch, or the manual steps below.
One press uses this TV\'s own debugging service. No computer or cable. The first time, the TV asks you to allow debugging. If it blocks that, the copy buttons below still work.
No on-TV ADB? Use a computer
These buttons copy the same commands to the clipboard. Paste them into a terminal with ADB access to this TV.
Disable commands copied. Paste them into a terminal with ADB access to this TV.
Restore commands copied. Paste them into a terminal with ADB access to this TV.
No commands were available. Reopen this screen to probe the TV again.
Connecting to this TV\'s ADB… If the TV asks, choose Allow.
An ADB action is already running.

leanlauncherTV will connect to this TV\'s own debugging service. This is the same access a computer with ADB has: it can disable the stock launcher and set the home app. The connection stays on this TV, and the restore button undoes the change.\n\nThe app keeps its debugging key in private storage. Continue only if you want this.
Could not reach this TV\'s ADB service. Turn on Network debugging in Settings, then try again. The copy buttons still work.
The TV did not finish allowing debugging. Accept the Allow USB debugging prompt, then try again. Tick Always allow if the TV offers it.
The app could not prepare its debugging key. Try again, or use the copy buttons.
The app could not switch its own home screen back on. Use Switch to leanlauncherTV below, then try again.
ADB could not run the commands: %1$s
Done. leanlauncherTV is now the home app.
Done. HOME now opens leanlauncherTV, but the TV rejected one command. Use the copy fallback if HOME misbehaves.
The commands ran, but HOME still opens %1$s. The TV may protect the home app; use the copy fallback or system settings.
Done. The stock launcher is enabled and HOME is back with it.
Stock launchers re-enabled. Now choose the stock launcher under Settings > Apps > Default apps > Home app.
The stock launchers were re-enabled, but HOME still opens %1$s. Choose the stock launcher in system settings, or use the copy fallback.

Optional. Photos change only while the home screen is visible. Built-in photos use Wallhaven\'s General category; its People category is excluded. Images stay in memory. Local files are read in place through Android\'s file picker.
Source: %1$s. It will load when you return to the home screen.
Paste a public page, feed or direct image address. The TV reads image links from it while the home screen is visible. Only use a site you trust.
Enter a valid http:// or https:// address.
Website saved. Images will load when you return to the home screen.
Some images may need choosing again after a restart.
This TV has no file picker. Copy images to the TV and use a file manager, or use the website option.
Wallhaven General category only. Its People and Anime categories are excluded.
